scope: Revalidate removal of unused passport-discord / passport on current main; custom Discord OAuth remains canonical.
finding: Current main keeps dashboard OAuth in src/dashboard/routes/auth.ts with custom Discord OAuth using state/PKCE. package.json contains neither passport nor passport-discord, and the architecture test forbids source imports/requires of either package.
decision: Keep the passport stack removed. No auth rewrite or dependency reintroduction is justified; custom OAuth remains the production path.

contracts.authPath: custom OAuth routes remain canonical (login/callback/logout + PKCE)
contracts.noPassportImport: src/** must not import or require passport or passport-discord
contracts.packageJson: passport and passport-discord plus related @types remain absent from dependencies/devDependencies
contracts.lockfileRuntimeCheck: npm ls passport passport-discord must remain empty
contracts.regression: existing authenticated OAuth/session/Playwright gates must remain green on the final Stage-54 SHA
contracts.shaRule: one complete CI/CD + Verification 2 + Playwright cycle is required on the final unchanged SHA
